compatibility_policy: Version-pinned compatibility for Kestra YAML, Pebble expressions, REST API, CLI, execution semantics and documented import/export formats; parity plus AMESH-specific capabilities.
production_backend_language: Python 3.12 asyncio durable core (ADR-016); the checked-in foundation is the production engine seed
production_deployment: On-premises Kubernetes via Helm; Docker Compose for development; single-host profile secondary
availability_slo: 99.9% monthly control-plane availability excluding declared maintenance
migration_depth: Full side-by-side migration of resources, identity/governance configuration, historical executions, task runs, logs, artifacts and audit evidence
ai_change_authority: Independent agent quorum may merge normal changes after deterministic gates; named human approval is required for security-sensitive changes, licensing/governance changes and stable releases
license_policy: AGPL-3.0-only; strongest network copyleft selected while retaining open-source status; no additional field-of-use restriction
